newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra up on dollar, U.S. drug sector rise.
newsitem.headline: Astra up on dollar, U.S. drug sector rise.

text.p: Swedish drug company Astra AB rose sharply on Thursday because of a strong dollar and gains in U.S. drug shares overnight.
At 1200 GMT the share traded at 336, 7.5 crowns over Wednesday's close.
"The strong dollar is pushing Astra. They have a lot of turnover in the U.S.," one broker said.
The U.S. pharmaceuticals sector index rose 2.4 percent in New York on Wednesday.

Another broker added foreign interest was pushing up the price. "The largest net buyer today was Union Bank of Switzerland, which shows there is buying interest from abroad. This is probably pushing the share up somewhat," a broker said.
